title: CoARA ERIP Outputs on Ethical Research Assessment in Data and AI
organization: CoARA Working Group on Ethics and Research Integrity Policy
what_changed: CoARA has consolidated a large implementation package: an ethical policy framework, a framework for evaluating digital contributions, methodological guidance, a handbook, controlled vocabulary and ontology, tool review, a Modular Assessment Configurator protocol, and five self-evaluation instruments. The consolidation and clarification of endorsement status is dated 20 October 2026.
why_it_matters: The package attempts to turn high-level responsible-assessment principles into organisational diagnostics and configurable procedures. The Observatory and self-evaluation toolkit have been submitted for formal CoARA endorsement as actionable policy resources. The underlying records predate the briefing period; what is new is the 20 October consolidation.
